title: Bulk actions on selected rows open a confirmation dialog and return focus to the originating row on close
asA: operator applying an action to multiple rows
iWant: each bulk action to open a confirmation dialog under the ARIA APG dialog-modal pattern and return focus to the row that opened it when the dialog closes
soThat: the destructive step never runs by accident and keyboard-only users are not stranded at the top of the surface

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered datatable with row-level checkboxes and a bulk action, when the operator toggles a row checkbox, the selection model records the row id and the bulk-action control reflects the new selection count in its accessible label or an adjacent status element.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered datatable with row-selection checkboxes
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator toggles a row checkbox
acceptanceCriteria.then: the accessible selection count updates by one

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given selected rows and a bulk-action control, when the operator activates the bulk action, a dialog opens with `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby` naming the action, and `aria-describedby` naming the affected count; the confirm control receives initial focus.
acceptanceCriteria.given: one or more rows selected in a rendered datatable
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator activates the bulk action
acceptanceCriteria.then: the dialog opens with `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby` set, and the confirm control receives initial focus

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given an open bulk-action confirmation dialog, when the operator closes it (confirm or cancel), focus returns to the row control (the row's selection checkbox or an equivalent row-scoped focus target) that originated the bulk action, per WCAG 2.4.3 and ARIA APG dialog-modal. The check selects a row, opens the dialog, cancels, and asserts the focused element is the originating row's checkbox. Probed by pack check AC-17104-3.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an open bulk-action confirmation dialog that originated on a specific row
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator closes the dialog (confirm or cancel)
acceptanceCriteria.then: focus returns to the originating row's control (the row-scoped focus target), not to the document body or an unrelated element

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the selection model's operator-configured maximum selection cap (an integer set on the shell factory), when the operator attempts to toggle a row that would exceed the cap, the shell refuses the toggle and announces the refusal through an aria-live polite region naming the cap value; the selection model records no change. Applying agent sets: the cap value on the shell factory input.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an operator toggling a row that would push the selection past the configured maximum cap
acceptanceCriteria.then: the toggle is refused, the selection model records no change, and an aria-live polite region announces the refusal naming the cap value

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given an open bulk-action confirmation dialog and the operator activates the Cancel control (or presses Escape), when the dialog closes, focus returns to the same row-scoped focus target the dialog opened FROM (the row's selection checkbox or the equivalent row-level focus target), not to the bulk-action control that opened it; a dialog that returns focus to the wrong target fails the pack check.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an open bulk-action confirmation dialog closed with Cancel or Escape
acceptanceCriteria.then: focus returns to the row-scoped focus target the dialog opened from, not to the bulk-action control

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given an open bulk-action confirmation dialog, when the operator presses Tab through the dialog controls, focus is trapped inside the dialog (Tab cycles between the dialog's focusable elements; it does not reach elements outside the dialog); a dialog whose Tab escapes to elements outside fails the pack check per ARIA APG dialog-modal.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an open bulk-action confirmation dialog and the operator pressing Tab
acceptanceCriteria.then: focus is trapped inside the dialog; Tab does not reach elements outside; escape fails the check
